verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Databricks' own orchestration surfaces: ETL pipelines described as being for data orchestration (Lakeflow pipelines), a versioned Jobs REST API, and SQL alerts that automatically evaluate query conditions and send notifications. None of these items explicitly says jobs or workflows can run on a recurring schedule, so the core of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of recurring/cron-style scheduling for jobs or workflows, trigger and schedule configuration details, AI-assisted (e.g., Genie Code) creation of schedules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
